title: TeamChanged
description: Published by Events to farol.events with routing key team.changed, through the outbox (ADR-004), whenever a team is created, renamed or given its categories (US-16), given its permissions (US-17) or deleted (US-16: kept with deleted true and a higher version); nothing publishes it before US-16. Consumed from auth-users.events-events, reports.events-events and transports.events-events (API outline §7.4, §7.5). Full state with a version (§7.3); a team never moves to another event. Stricter than what Reports reads (#214, consumed/team.changed.schema.json): every permission carries reportTypes, empty unless the permission is Reports.Review. Report type codes are proposed until US-17 (spec D6). AMQP properties as EventChanged, with type = TeamChanged.

reportTypes.description: Only Reports.Review carries any (proposed codes, spec D6)
